name: Zhilin Ou
affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
about: I am an MPhil student in Artificial Intelligence at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, advised by Prof. Wenjing Ma. My research interests lie in embodied AI, robot learning, and 3D vision. Through this work, I hope to build robots that learn from experience, adapt to new situations, and support people with care.

I received my B.Eng. in Digital Media Technology from Dalian University of Technology, where I conducted research with Prof. Zhihui Wang on computer vision and multimodal learning. I have also collaborated with the PLAN Lab at UIUC on embodied AI and 3D vision research.

photographs.alt: Two golden-furred monkeys sitting behind glass
photographs.title: On the other side of the glass
photographs.caption: A mother monkey and her baby, with glass between us. Its green tint makes it look almost as though they are in a forest. It is actually quite painful to look at.
photographs.note: 猴子媽媽和寶寶，我們隔著玻璃。玻璃綠綠的，好像他們在叢林一樣，其實蠻難受的……

photographs.alt: A tiger being fed through a barrier at Dalian Zoo
photographs.title: A wider world
photographs.caption: Feeding a tiger. This photograph feels oppressive to me. Visits to the zoo always leave me sad; these animals could have had a much wider, freer world.
photographs.note: 餵食老虎。看這張會有一種壓抑的感覺，去動物園總是讓我感到難過。他們本來擁有更廣闊、更自由的世界。
photographs.altZh: 大連動物園裡，隔著屏障餵食老虎的場景

photographs.alt: Two red tomatoes held in a garden
photographs.title: Two kinds of tomatoes
photographs.caption: A vegetable farmer picked two varieties for me to try. One was called kougan tomato; I have forgotten the other name. Both were delicious!
photographs.note: 菜農叔叔摘了兩種不同品種的番茄給我嘗。一個叫口感番茄，另一個叫什麼番茄來著，我有一點忘記。很好吃！
photographs.altZh: 在米易縣的菜地裡，手中拿著兩種番茄

photographs.note: 和媽媽在攀枝花撿攀枝花。攀枝花也是木棉花的名字；花蕊可以食用，可以炒臘肉。
photographs.title: Picking panzhihua in Panzhihua
photographs.altZh: 和媽媽在米易縣撿攀枝花時，手中拿著一朵紅色木棉花

photographs.alt: A shipwreck in a snowy rocky cove in Dalian
photographs.title: A long way to a shipwreck
photographs.caption: The shipwreck had only recently been towed here. It took four hours on the metro and another hour and a half on foot to reach it. Snow was falling, and little animals' tracks were everywhere. I was frightened, but thankfully a friend held my hand along the way. An unforgettable journey.
photographs.note: 這艘沉船剛被拖到這裡，超級超級遠，需要坐四個小時的地鐵，再徒步一個半小時才能看到。當時在下雪，到處都是小動物的腳印，我很害怕，還好有朋友拉著我。很難忘的經歷。
photographs.altZh: 冬日大連的岩石海灣裡，一艘被拖到岸邊的沉船

photoStoryAlt: A red kapok flower from a day picking panzhihua with my mother in Panzhihua, my hometown
sceneStory: I’m also a photographer. This photo recalls picking panzhihua—kapok flowers—with my mother in Panzhihua, my hometown. The flower and the city share a Chinese name. Here, that memory meets Baymax and the warmth I hope robots can offer.
